index.html.title: Introduction | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
index.html.keywords: Introduction SmartUiScaler is a replacement for uGUI CanvasScaler component with advanced functionality that lets you easily develop UI layouts for every device and any screen size. Features: UIs positioning into screen safe area; Easy control of UIs expanasion from reference resolution to full screen resolution; Easy UI layouts scale control; UiScalers grouping and easy group options setting; Implemented saving and loading to PlayerPrefs with interface for custom saving and loading; Works with overlay and camera space canvases. Editor tools for UI layouts testing, screen safe area simulation. Requirements: Unity version 2022.3.0 and newer.

manual/custom_ui_scaler.html.title: Custom Ui Scaler | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/custom_ui_scaler.html.keywords: Custom Ui Scaler Custom Ui Scaler needs to be created when parent canvas has Camera Screen Space Render Mode and attached camera renders to Render Texture, as Smart Ui Scaler cant receive the screen space area of the rendered image of the canvas. To create a Custom Ui Scaler extend the CoreUiScaler. These two methos must be implemented: Provide screen space Rect of the Render Texture output image. protected abstract Rect GetScreenRect() Convert screen space Rect to world space Rect. protected abstract Rect ScreenRectToWorldRect(Rect screenRect)

manual/getting_started.html.title: Getting started | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/getting_started.html.keywords: Getting started This guide will help you to setup initial SmartUiScaler. Create a new GameObject inside your Canvas; Add the SmartUiScaler component to this GameObject. The RectTransform of this GameObject will be driven by SmartUiScaler and will automatically resize; At first the SmartUiScaler will work in "Fitted Reference Resolution" mode. You can see in Scene View that Canvas is represented with gray border and SmartUiScaler has green border. This mode is recomended for editing Ui layouts inside SmartUiScaler and to place objects without overlapping; Lets add Ui objects into our SmartUiScaler. As an example here is 4 added RawImages anchored to the corners of the SmartUiScaler; Now to test the SmartUiScaler with our UI layout we can open "Smart Ui Scaler" window under "Tools" > "Smart Ui Scaler"; This tool helps to test scaling without entering into Play Mode. Here we can change the current scaling mode into "Preview". This mode works exactly as it would in Play Mode; We can now see that out SmartUiScaler takes up full area of the Canvas. Now you can test all the SmartUiScaler component Options to see them in effect; Note In "Preview" mode SmartUiScalers border changes into Red color. This indicates that it is not advised to change the inner UI layout in this mode. Change back the "Scaling Mode" in "Smart Ui Scaler" window to "Fitted Reference Resolution". SmartUiScaler will resize to reference resolution and you can continue to work on your UI layout. At this point you can remove the CanvasScaler component from Canvas object as it not needed. Note As an alternative, cloasing the "Smart Ui Scaler" window will also rest the "Scaling Mode" to "Fitted Reference Resolution". These steps are the basics of creating and testing your UI layout with an initial setup that should cover most of the use cases.

manual/smart_expander_component.html.title: Smart Expander component | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/smart_expander_component.html.keywords: Smart Expander component Used to expand Rect Transform outside of the parent UiScaler to parent Canvas borders. How it works Smart Expander component depends on parent Rect Transform. It follows this parent Rect Transforms size and uses it as a base from where to expand to canvas borders. The four expansion fields are used to tell the Smart Expander to what directions it should expand. Showcase Here is a simple example. The black rectangle represent the safe area, it goes up all the way to the top border of the screen. The header is at the top and its background with teal color has the Smart Expander component. In the first screenshot you can see that the header is inside the safe area and the Smart Expander does not do anything as no expansion field is selected. After we set the expansion to left and right borders of the screen we can now see that the header expands outside the safe area to full length of the screen. You can find the implementation of this example inside the Demo 3 of the plugin.

manual/smart_size_limiter_component.html.title: Smart Size Limiter component | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/smart_size_limiter_component.html.keywords: Smart Size Limiter component Limits the size of Rect Transform to assigned min and max aspect ratios. Field Description Reference Height Height that is set to Rect Transform and used to calculate width for current aspect ratio. Default value is 1000 and cant be lower or equal to 0. Min Aspect Ratio Minimum limit for aspect ratio. 0 value is unlmited. Max Aspect Ratio Maximum limit for aspect ratio. 0 value is unlmited. Note Smart Size Limiter component can work without Smart Ui Limiter in parent hierarchy. How it works Smart Size Limiter component depends on parent Rect Transform. It uses the parents Rect Transform size to calculate the appropriate aspect ratio of Smart Size Limiter Rect Transform. If parents size is between the allowed aspect ratios then the full parents size will be occupied, otherwise it will be limited.

manual/smart_ui_scaler_component.html.title: Smart Ui Scaler component | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/smart_ui_scaler_component.html.keywords: Smart Ui Scaler component The main component of this plugin. Replacement for Canvas Scaler. Warning This Ui Scaler only works in Canvases with Overlay Screen Space Render Mode or Camera Screen Space Render Mode where attached camera is rendering directly to screen. When attached camera renders to Render Texture - this Ui Scaler cant receive the screen space area of the rendered image and this information should be additionaly provided. Group field Used to assign Ui Scaler into shared group with shared options. For more information see Ui Scaler groups. Option fields These fields are used when Ui Scaler is not assigned into a group. Field Description Reference Resolution The resolution the UI layout is designed for. Use Safe Area Use only the screens safe area or whole canvas screen area. Alignment Controls the alignemnt inside canvas screen area. Content Scale Controls the children scale. Recommended scale is [0.1, 1.0]. Expand Progress Controls occupied space between reference resolution and canvas screen area. Allowed value is [0.0, 1.0].

manual/smart_ui_scaler_editor_window.htm.title: Smart Ui Scaler editor window | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/smart_ui_scaler_editor_window.htm.keywords: Smart Ui Scaler editor window Smart Ui Scaler window helps to test and debug UI layouts. It can be found under "Tools" > "Smart Ui Scaler"; Presets field This field is used to apply presets scriptable object values to Smart Ui Scaler window. To create a new presets scriptable object Right Click on Project Window then navigate to "SmartUiScaler" > "Editor" > "UiScalerEditorPresets". Warning UiScalerEditorPresets scriptable object should be placed inside "Editor" folder as this scriptable object only works in Editor. Presets scriptable object has the same options as Smart Ui Scaler window. Presets options will be applied when Presets scriptable object is selected. They can be reapplied by pressing the "Reapply Presets" button. Scaling Mode field Scaling Mode field controls how UiScalers are scaled in Edit Mode. Scaling Mode Description Fitted Reference Resolution Sets the size of UiScalers to reference resolution and scales them to fit inside their Canvased. This mode is recommended for UI development and is most convenient to work with. Reference Resolution Sets the size of UiScalers to reference resolution and keeps the scale to represent their reference resolution 1:1 in Unity units. This mode is also intended for UI development. Preview Enables full UiScalers resizing that represents how UiScalers will look like in Play Mode. It is not recommended edit UI layout when this mode is enabled. Note This field only works in Edit Mode and is ignored in Play Mode. Simulate Safe Area and Area fields These fields control the simulated screen safe area. To activate the safe area simulation enable the Simulate Safe Area toggle. The Area fields control unsafe areas from every screen border in pixels. Note Safe area simulation fields also work in Play Mode.

manual/ui_scaler_groups.html.title: Ui Scaler groups | Smart Ui Scaler plugin
manual/ui_scaler_groups.html.keywords: Ui Scaler groups Ui Scaler Groups are used to share and control Ui Scaler options between Ui Scalers. Ui Scaler Groups are controlled through their scriptable objects. To create a Ui Scaler Group scriptable object Right Click on Project Window then navigate to "SmartUiScaler" > "UiScalerGroup". Ui Scaler Group scriptable object has Default Options that can be changed in the inspector. As the name suggests, these options are used initially. Once they are changed through Ui Scaler Group scriptable object scriptin API they will be overridden. To assign SmartUiScaler to this group drag Ui Scaler Group scriptable object into SmartUiScaler Group field. SmartUiScaler Options field will disappear as these options will no longer be used. Ui Scaler Group options can be changed through scripting API using the Ui Scaler Group scriptable object reference. See UiScalerGroupSo. Once the options are changed all active SmartUiScalers will automatically update. Demo2 showcases how Ui Scaler Groups work. Initialy Ui Scaler Group options are not saved and loaded. To have persistent Ui Scaler Group options the easiest way is to use UiScalerGroupsPlayerPrefsManager component. Just add this component to an empty GameObject in the first scene in your project. It works by saving the options into PlayerPrefs when the game is closed and loads these options when this component is activated. For more advanced scenarious a custom saving and loading can be implemented through UiScalerGroups class GetSaveData() and SetSaveData(UiScalerGroupsSaveData) static methods.
